name: Extreme heat
summary: Heatwave warnings in parts of Queensland; no top-tier warnings over large populations found
state: Heatwave warnings have been issued for parts of Queensland and northern Australia as the Southern Hemisphere warms (The Nightly; IQAir). Zimbabwe is bracing for a hot, dry El Niño season (NewsDay). As of 7 Nov no deadly heatwave or top-tier warning covering a large population was found, so the level stays Normal, but the risk is rising.
for_you: In hot weather follow your national met service and health advice, such as the Bureau of Meteorology in Australia.
rubric_hit: No deadly heatwave with top-tier warnings over large populations = Normal

sources.title: The Nightly — Heatwave health warning issued for large parts of Queensland

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
